Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Update requires: Replacement

NetworkResourceScopeType.description: Associate by scope instead of directly. When set, NetworkResourceId is the ID of the scope (an account ID, a VPC ID, or a subnet ID) and the association covers every eligible network resource in that scope; when omitted, NetworkResourceId is a direct network resource (for example a NAT gateway or instance) and must match the policy's NetworkResourceType.
NetworkResourceScopeType.markdownDescription:
Associate by scope instead of directly. When set, NetworkResourceId is the ID of the scope (an account ID, a VPC ID, or a subnet ID) and the association covers every eligible network resource in that scope; when omitted, NetworkResourceId is a direct network resource (for example a NAT gateway or instance) and must match the policy's NetworkResourceType.
